capabilities.guarantee: Authenticated opaque tenant/project/run and Harness identities are HMAC-bound end to end. The token stays out of LangGraph state, tool messages, and persisted Temporal manifests; missing, tampered, or mismatched authority disables governance without stopping ordinary design execution.

capabilities.capability: single durable event transport and Runtime idempotency
capabilities.guarantee: Strictly sanitized AHE records use stable record_id values; Runtime persists them with event_key ahe:<record_id>, so subprocess replay and recovery reuse the original event sequence independently of browser subscription.
Raw prompts, requirements, free-form evidence, authority tokens, and private scope claims are excluded from AHE records and LangGraph tool-call messages.

Ordinary design errors route to revision/HITL, infrastructure transients route to retry, and only allowlisted deterministic contradictions carry Harness provenance and stable reason codes. Repair-capable real Selection and SchematicConnections steps preserve Harness observation recoverability after local repair is exhausted.

Only scoped, allowlisted observations from at least two independent opaque runs and projects promote a capability gap. Global signatures exclude project-local reference designators; the tenant+Harness+project ledger stores and unions per-project affected_refs. It closes only after the same stable invariant is executed successfully for every recorded local subject, with bound signature, step, gap_id, and strict resolution attribution. Missing evidence, removed subjects, or a different alias function cannot close it.

A scoped strict Harness observation is still appended to the per-workflow audit and Runtime bridge if cross-run EHE storage raises OSError; only promotion is skipped. Unscoped governed events never leave local diagnostics.
Wrong PB2/PF0, no verified alias, a pulldown tied to supply, and fixed_exact without evidence remain fail-closed design/evidence results rather than systemic Harness defects.

Internal knowledge lookup can reuse verified EHE strategies only after validating hidden configurable authority; those claims are removed before messages/UI output. Legacy unscoped lookup remains limited to ungoverned local/RAG evidence.

Recorded-only fixture and fault-injection metadata are retained for future grader integration. They were not executed by a deterministic grader in this increment and are not claimed as passing executable eval evidence.
